unresolved_items: GDPR currentness remains unresolved outside this addendum.

evidence_candidates.claim: Amended AI Act Article 27(4) allows a deployer, where obligations under that Article are already met through a GDPR Article 35 DPIA or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680 assessment, to include cross-references to relevant DPIA sections or include relevant parts in the fundamental-rights impact assessment.
qualifiers: This candidate supersedes the earlier SRC-0011 Page 224 wording for Article 27(4).

evidence_candidates.claim: Amended AI Act Article 27(5) requires the AI Office to develop a questionnaire template, including through an automated tool, and states that the template should, where relevant, allow deployers to include cross-references to relevant DPIA sections or relevant parts in the FRIA.
qualifiers: This candidate supersedes the earlier SRC-0011 Page 224 wording for Article 27(5).

evidence_candidates.claim: The amended AI Act Article 113 schedule provides that Chapter III Sections 1, 2 and 3 apply from 2 December 2027 for systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(2) and Annex III, and from 2 August 2028 for systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(1) and Annex I, subject to the stated exception for Article 6(5).
qualifiers: The application date must be selected by the applicable high-risk classification route; it is not a universal date for every AI system.
evidence_candidates.relevance: Temporal qualifier for Article 26 and Article 27 applicability.

classification_proposals.basis: Official amending Regulation (EU) 2026/1744; the source is classified BINDING and its entry into force is separately supported by the reviewed Page 41 unit.
